shortDescription: Perform Protection policy operations for PowerStore storage system

options.name: array_ip
options.description: IP or FQDN of the PowerStore management system.

options.name: description
options.description: String variable. Indicates the description of the protection policy.

options.name: name
options.description: String variable. Indicates the name of the protection policy.

options.name: new_name
options.description: String variable. Indicates the new name of the protection policy. Used for renaming operation.

options.name: password
options.description: The password of the PowerStore host.

options.name: port
options.description: Port number for the PowerStore array. If not passed, it will take 443 as default.

options.name: protectionpolicy_id
options.description: String variable. Indicates the id of the protection policy.

options.name: replicationrule
options.description: The name or ids of the replcation rule which is to be added to the protection policy. To remove the replication rule, an empty string has to be passed.

options.name: snapshotrule_state
options.description: String variable. Indicates the state of a snapshotrule in a protection policy. When snapshot rules are specified, this variable is required. Value C(present-in-policy) indicates to add to protection policy. Value C(absent-in-policy) indicates to remove from protection policy.

options.name: snapshotrules
options.description: List of strings to specify the name or ids of snapshot rules which are to be added or removed, to or from, the protection policy.

options.name: state
options.description: String variable. Indicates the state of protection policy. For Delete operation only, it should be set to C(absent). For all other operations like Create, Modify or Get details, it should be set to C(present).

options.name: timeout
options.description: Time after which the connection will get terminated. It is to be mentioned in seconds.

options.name: user
options.description: The username of the PowerStore host.

options.name: validate_certs
options.description: Boolean variable to specify whether to validate SSL certificate or not. C(true) - indicates that the SSL certificate should be verified. Set the environment variable REQUESTS_CA_BUNDLE to the path of the SSL certificate. C(false) - indicates that the SSL certificate should not be verified.
